Specification: This module defines an additional constraint and a liveness property for a system specified in the imported InnerSequential module. It introduces a constant bound MaxQLen and a state constraint requiring every process's operation queue length to be at most that bound. It also defines a liveness property stating that whenever a register entry at some process is not in the "Free" state, it will eventually return to the "Free" state; the module itself contains no actions or proofs and relies on definitions such as Proc, Reg, opQ, and regFile from the extended module.
